youtube.title: The Gods Begged Rudra to Hold His Power | Ramayana Ep 11
youtube.description:
The gods once feared a child not yet born. 🏔️

On the bank of the Ganga, Rama asked how the river came to flow on three paths, and Vishvamitra began with the story of her sister Uma. Rudra and Uma were wed, and dwelt as one for a hundred years of the gods. Yet no son came, and all the gods, led by Brahma, wondered who could withstand the child to come. They bowed before Rudra and begged him to hold his power within, for the good of the three worlds. Rudra agreed, but asked who would bear the power already stirred. The gods chose the Earth, and his power spread over hills and woods. Then Agni entered it with the Wind, and it became a white mountain and a divine reed forest, glowing like fire and the sun. Denied the son she longed for, Uma cursed the gods in anger: their wives would bear no child. And she cursed the Earth never to know the joy of a son. Then Rudra went with Uma to a peak of Himavan for tapas. This, said the sage, was Uma's story; now hear the Ganga's tale.

📜 On screen (Valmiki Ramayana 1.36.11, vulgate):
"Trailokyahitakāmārthaṃ tejas tejasi dhāraya, rakṣa sarvān imāṁl lokān nālokaṃ kartum arhasi"
(For the good of the three worlds, hold your power within your power; protect all these worlds, do not unmake them.)
